status: Estimates awaiting the owner's review. Hours for a fix led by a consultant who knows Salesforce, as a range in whole hours. A fixed range covers the work whatever the size of the org. A range for each unit is multiplied by the count the finding holds (the sum of the facts named, or of all its facts), rounded up to whole hours. Past the cap, a rule whose work stops growing says why and holds the range at the cap; every other rule's range covers only the first units the cap allows, and says the rest is scoped separately. Printed in no document until approved.
